h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Tirupati

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Tirupati

c: Tirupati is best known for the hill temple at Tirumala, but the town below has universities, a large student population and growing residential areas. FunPlay Systems is an outdoor gym equipment supplier in Tirupati for university and college campuses, schools, municipal parks, temple trust properties and housing layouts. Our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, is about 940 km away, and machines reach Andhra Pradesh by road.

Summers here are very hot, and the town gets rain from both monsoons. Our galvanised frames and roto-moulded parts are made for long outdoor use in both conditions. We suggest a set based on who will use the gym, send a layout drawing, and install with our own team or a dealer in south India after you approve. Temple trust properties usually need only a few gentle machines in a quiet corner.

items.q: Can a university campus in Tirupati order an outdoor gym?
items.a: Yes. Share the open space, the expected number of users and any purchase process. We will send machine details, a layout drawing and a quote.

items.q: Are outdoor gym machines suitable for visitors at a trust property?
items.a: Yes, gentle machines such as walkers, twisters and tai chi wheels suit visitors of all ages. Place them in a shaded, quiet corner away from crowd routes.

items.q: How long is the warranty on the frames?
items.a: Galvanised pipes and roto-moulded parts carry a 3-year warranty against manufacturing defects. Springs, bearings and spare parts carry 1 year.
